Normal passed+accepted implementation validator cannot accept this authority.

Actual selected Node/npm versions, component package/locks/dependency graph/oneEffect and portable artifact module bytes remain checked locally; archived host binary paths are not portable consumer prerequisites.

embedded_raw_evidence_contract.scope: Immutable source-only approval and original partial receipt evidence; no source data or behavioral/native/module/grant/public authority.
embedded_raw_evidence_contract.validation_order: Verify pinned outer tracked cohort bytes first. Require exact closed blob keyset/version/encoding; exact original historical_path metadata, safe integer bytes and exact independently pinned SHA256. Require primitive ASCII canonical padded RFC4648 base64, no whitespace/url-safe substitutions, exact4*ceil(bytes/3) encoded length. Decode, require re-encoded base64 equals original string, exact decoded length and raw SHA256 BEFORE strict fatal UTF8 decoding and JSON parse. Never refresh expected SHA, decode from candidate output, normalize/reserialize expected raw, or open historical_path.
